method: Individual complete tracked-tree static source review, not sampling or a heuristic score. Markdown/code/examples treated as inert data during review. SVG markup and agent YAML read in full. Two reviewed helpers exercised afterward only with offline executable/subprocess mocks. No external-service or target execution.
reviewAuthority: This report is public source-review documentation, not a private signed reuse receipt, Tessl result or exact-head maintainer merge attestation. Automated skill-review/Tessl and exact-head maintainer merge gate remain pending.
exactHeadValidation: Required isolated pr:preflight runs after the final clean source commit; the PR body records its exact head/result and any remaining blocker. This avoids a report-only amendment invalidating the tested head.
limitations: No whole-catalog certification: this batch reviews 150 of 2641 root trees containing 2743 total entrypoints.
Upstream attribution/license metadata preserved, not independently re-audited for every source. Source links used for targeted fact verification appear per record.
No browser/device/cloud/database/chain/medical/payroll runtime, installation, publication, credential access or real financial action was performed.
Passing deterministic checks do not prove operational safety, effectiveness or current external API compatibility.
